subject: Application: Software Engineer (Remote) — Andi Agung Dwi Arya
body:
Dear LinQue Resourcing Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the remote Software Engineer contract role. Your required stack — TypeScript, Next.js, React, and Python — is exactly where I've spent the last 5+ years, shipping over 200 end-to-end projects (80 in TypeScript, 36 in Python) as an independent full-stack engineer.

Three proofs relevant to this role:

1. Production at scale: I engineered Saku Sultan, a React Native/Expo fintech e-wallet live on both Google Play (com.saku_sultan) and the App Store, and I maintain SINTEKMu, an enterprise faculty dashboard running in production at https://simtekmu.teknik.unismuh.ac.id. Most of my systems stay in production 12-16 months under my continued maintenance.

2. AI-native workflow: I work daily with AI coding tools (I hold my own GitHub Copilot license) and have built LLM-powered products, including a private Go backend with a full RAG pipeline (PDF ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval) powering a live product — happy to demo it. My Python work covers Indonesian NLP: summarization, paraphrasing, and semantic plagiarism detection with IndoBERT and mT5.

3. Specs and client-facing work: As a freelance engineer I routinely turn vague client ideas into formal technical specifications, scoped deliverables, and working products — from database schema to polished UI — including multi-tenant SaaS and a digital-election platform with RBAC and audit trails.

I hold a B.Eng. in Informatics (GPA 3.92/4.00, Best Graduate), write fluently in English, and am fully set up for remote contract work from Makassar, Indonesia (UTC+8).

My portfolio: github.com/devnolife — my tailored resume is attached.

Best regards,
Andi Agung Dwi Arya
andiagung193@gmail.com | +62 851 7107 9607
